newsitem.title: USA: RESEACH ALERT - Seagate cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEACH ALERT - Seagate cut to hold.

text.p: SoundView Financial analyst Mark Specker said he cut his short-term rating on Seagate Technology Inc to a hold from a buy, citing upcoming competition at the high-end of the market.
-- Specker's long-term rating remains unchanged at hold.
-- Specker said his fiscal 1997 estimates are unchanged at $3.40 a share and 1998 estimates unchanged at $4.48 a share.

-- "I don't feel we have a lot of upside," Specker said. "The issue really is that we probably have a situtation where they continue to lose some market share from the high-end with new competitors coming in."
